panels.description: At Keel’s pump station, restored water bursts into waiting jugs. Show only hands, containers, and water, never a recognizable crowd. Keep the normal-allocation display high and left, the SFX in the lower-left water area, and the queue worker’s balloon in the upper-right.

In the mine gallery, the original node pulses down its cable while a local shutter descends. Keep the SFX in the upper-left mechanical space, Bi11bot’s balloon in the upper-right, Alex’s reply in lower-right, and Bi11bot’s joke in lower-left.

Alex runs through the narrowing shutter gap with the tool bag over one shoulder and folded Bi11bot as a clearly separate bundle beneath the other arm. Keep the original node visible behind the grille. Put the SFX vertically along the far-left shutter edge, away from Alex’s balloon upper-right and Bi11bot’s balloon lower-right.

Alex reaches the colder side chamber as the shutter slams. Bi11bot unfolds against his chest; the same original node pulses behind the grille. Put the SFX in the far-left metal area and reserve upper-right for Bi11bot’s balloon and lower-right for Alex.
